content:
maria_sales: Hey team — StraitsBridge (large fintech) wants to run a POC next week. They're asking if our catalog includes models with instruction-following + code understanding for financial docs. Also they want quantized variants and on-prem option. CC: @devin_se @sarah_sec

devin_se: I can run a compatibility scan — what dataset size and latency SLO? Also any token pricing constraints?

maria_sales: They expect ~100 reqs/sec peak, 1-2s p50, budget ~ $25k/month for hosted usage during POC. Security: must pass standard questionnaire and support customer-managed KMS + VPC.

sarah_sec: KMS + VPC ok on Private. For hosted, we offer SSE with BYOK on Dedicated? Need to confirm. Send questionnaire PDF.

nate_prod: Model fit: recommend rdl-3b-instruct for code+doc; has quantized int8 variants we validated. But for 100 rps with 1-2s p50, might need Dedicated pool with 2x A100 or Private on-prem. Latency depends on sequence length.

maria_sales: Customer will send sample doc sizes ~2k tokens average. Can we enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts?

devin_se: Yes, runtime supports KV caching; can configure per-route. For POC we'll enable caching and small batch sizes. I'll run a perf sim. ETA end of day.

sarah_sec: We need to answer legal about data retention — default hosted retention is 30 days; Private has no retention. I'll draft responses.

tim_sales: Pricing Q: if they go Dedicated, what's monthly commit estimate? Also what's incremental cost if they require k-anonymization logs?

nate_prod: Dedicated: estimate $25k/mo for reserved A100 equivalent to meet SLO at that load with caching. K-anon logs add support cost — probably $2-4k/mo. I'll confirm with finance.

maria_sales: Customer asked about model variants: can we fall back to smaller variant during spikes? e.g., 3B -> 1.5B with lower quality.

devin_se: Yes, router policies support weighted fallback by latency/cost; we can pin rollout. Need to add variants to catalog and run compat tests for instruction tuning differences. I'll kick off variant-compat job.

devin_se: Runner command I used: ```python run_compat.py --model rdl-3b-instruct --variants rdl-1_5b-instruct,rdl-3b-quant-int8 --samples 500``` — results should be in /tmp/compat-straitbridge-21687.json (I will upload)

maria_sales: Can you also add them to POC billing as a separate rate card so they can track usage?

tim_sales: Yes. @finance-bot can you create provisional quote for StraitsBridge: Dedicated $25k, add-on K-anon $3k, support 24/7 $5k. POC discount 20%.

finance-bot: Quote created: Q-2168723456. PDF uploaded to the thread.

sarah_sec: Questionnaire: we need to confirm encryption at rest and in transit, SOC2 scope, and incident response time. I'll attach answers and mark items needing legal.

maria_sales: Great. Devin, next steps: perf sim, variant compat run, upload logs. Sarah to finish security responses. Tim to push quote. I'll coordinate POC kickoff call with customer for Tue 10am PT.

devin_se: Perf sim started (job 7891). Initial numbers show 1.8s p50 on a single 80GB A100 for 3B with caching enabled. If that doesn't meet SLO we'll scale to a dedicated pool.

maria_sales: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the call and update the SOW draft.
